newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to announce new gvt structure on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to announce new gvt structure on Friday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will sign an order on a new Russian government structure on Friday, Interfax news agency quoted the Kremlin leader as telling media editors.

The wording used by Yeltsin did not make clear if he would announce the personnel line-up of the cabinet, being formed on his orders by Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and his first deputy Anatoly Chubais, or just the cabinet's structure.
Yeltsin said that the new government would be "cardinally different" from the previous one, though some of its members would keep their posts.

"The most important thing is that the people who will come will have new, fresh ideas and thoughts," Interfax quoted him as saying, adding that representatives from the regions would join the cabinet.
Yeltsin did not mention any names, apart from praising Communications Minister Vasily Bulgak, but added there would be seven deputy prime ministers and one first deputy premier.
The old structure had three first deputies to Chernomyrdin and nine deputies.
